# Calorimetry source data

The frozen benchmark was constructed from ThermoML-derived source material.

The development-time source payload named:

`tracks/calorimetry/calorimetry_raw.json`

is intentionally not redistributed in the anonymous release. Its frozen
checksum is recorded in the repository-level
`SOURCE_DATA_CHECKSUMS.tsv`:

`1ef26f154ad7687892344a70b65a1c20841df8b0705d0cb4c68333691a77371a`

This omission does not affect the included frozen manifests, benchmark worlds,
recorded model outputs, grades, verification artifacts, gold standards, or
paper-facing score reproduction.

To rebuild source-derived calorimetry substrates from scratch, obtain the
relevant source material from the official NIST ThermoML archive under the
applicable upstream terms:

https://www.nist.gov/mml/acmd/trc/thermoml/thermoml-archive

See `DATA_SOURCES_AND_LICENSES.md` for the release policy.
